candidates.title: VibeCon SF 2026 - Vibecode Your Way to a YC Interview
candidates.evidence:
Hosted By
Y Combinator
VibeCon SF 2026
Saturday, October 24
San Francisco, CA
Capacity 250
About Event
## About

This isn't your regular hackathon.

Over one weekend, 175 hand-picked builders will come together at Y Combinator's SF office to turn their boldest ideas into working products.

Some of them write code every day. Many don't. That's the point. At VibeCon, founders, engineers, product managers, designers, operators and people who've spent years in sales, finance or business build side by side with AI. Past finalists had never written a line of code and shipped real products anyway.

Over two days, you'll:

 Build a working product from scratch, on a team or solo
 Get hands-on help from mentors from Emergent and our partners
 Build through the night if you want. The overnight block is optional
 Demo to pod judges, and if you make the Top 10, pitch on the main stage to a judging panel from YC, Emergent and our partners

Use any tools that make you fast, including Claude, coding agents or anything else, but your final product ships and demos on Emergent. Every builder gets free Emergent credits at the venue.

## What's at stake

 🏆 Winner: a direct interview for an upcoming Y Combinator batch, plus $10,000
 Runner-up: $5,000
 Third place: $3,000
 Top 10: a spot on the main stage, plus Emergent credits and partner perks
 Every builder: free Emergent credits, partner perks and swag

## Sponsors

Hero Sponsor: MongoDB

More partners to be announced soon.

## Agenda

Saturday, October 24

 8:00–9:30 AM — Registration, check-in & breakfast
 9:30–10:30 AM — Kickoff, welcome note, sponsors, theme & rules
 10:30 AM–1:00 PM — Build Sprint #1
 1:00–2:00 PM — Lunch
 2:00–2:30 PM — Fireside chat with YC and Emergent leadership
 2:30–6:00 PM — Build Sprint #2
 6:00–7:00 PM — Dinner
 7:00 PM–7:30 AM (Overnight) — Build Sprint #3, optional overnight time slot

Sunday, October 25

 8:00–9:00 AM — Breakfast
 9:00 AM–12:00 PM — Final build block
 12:00 PM — Video Submission deadline and build freeze
 12:00–1:00 PM — Lunch
 1:00–3:00 PM — Pod Judging
 3:30 PM — Top 10 announced
 3:30–5:00 PM — Top 10 preparation
 4:00–5:00 PM — Dinner
 5:00–6:30 PM — Live final demos, Q&A, winners announced and wrap-up

## Who should apply

 You have an ambitious idea and want to ship it this weekend, whether or not you write the code yourself
 You're a founder, engineer, product manager, designer, operator or business professional with 2+ years of experience
 You're pre-seed or pre-company and want a real shot at a YC interview
 You can be in San Francisco on October 24–25

## Why join

 Build inside YC's SF office alongside 175 equally driven people
 Get mentoring from teams who build AI products every day
 Win a prize that can change your trajectory: a direct YC interview

## How to apply

1. Fill out the application on this page
2. Tell us who you are, what you've built and what you want to build at VibeCon
3. Accepted builders get a confirmation email with everything they need to prepare

candidates.title: Haunted Hacks: Real-Time AI Edition
candidates.evidence:
Hosted By
Y Combinator
Haunted Hacks
Saturday, October 31
San Francisco, CA
Capacity 225
About Event
Come join us for Haunted Hacks to kick off Halloween this year. Hosted by [Terse](https://www.useterse.ai/) (F26) and [AgentRelay](https://agentrelay.com/) (F26), brought to you by OpenAI, Mastra (W25), Supabase (S20) and Freestyle (F24).

Every participant will receive:

 $100 in OpenAI API credits per participant.
 $25 in Supabase credits per each attendee (equivalent to 1 free month of Pro plan)

Love Durable Objects? Come build with our Open Source alternative!

Tired of copy/pasting messages between your agents? Come see how much you can build when you let agents collaborate directly with Agent Relay!

Want to do both at the same time? Even better!

Lunch, snacks, candy, bad Halloween/AI puns, swag, coffee, and prizes are all included.

Tracks include:

 Hackathon winner: A guaranteed YC interview
 Stateful Apps: Build with[ durable-actors](https://github.com/TerseAI/durable-actors) from Terse - iPhone Duo
 Agent to agent communication built with Agent Relay: Mac Mini
 Costume contest: Bragging rights

### October 31, 2026 · San Francisco, CA

### Eligibility

We recommend working in groups, and we're happy to help you form a team if you're coming on your own.

This is an in-person event in San Francisco. You must be able to attend on-site to participate.

Attendees must be 16 or older.

### Schedule

 10:00am - 11:00am: Doors Open + Registration
 11:00am: Hacking begins
 1:00pm: Lunch
 4:00pm: Submission deadline
 4:00pm - 5:00pm: Judging
 5:00pm - 6:00pm: Award Ceremony


What to build

The Actor world is hot right now. Come build your own Software Factory, long-running agent, multiplayer AI system or something super creative you've been itching to try out.

### Projects should ideally use either Durable actors, or Agent Relay (bonus points if you use both at the same time).


Rules

All code must be created at the hackathon.

Thinking of ideas before the hackathon is fine.

### Judging


We will be using devpost! We recommend setting up your account ahead of time.

The top entries will demo live at the end of the event, and judges will select winners from those demos.

Judges are looking for either very well-executed products or incredibly creative use cases using Durable Actors and Agent Relay. Again, bonus points if you can do both!

Judges will be announced soon.

### Prizes

The best overall project will receive a guaranteed YC Interview, $5k in OpenAI API credits and 3 months free of Mastra Platform.

The second place team will receive $2.5k in OpenAI API Credits and 2 months free of Mastra Platform.

The third place team will receive $1k in OpenAI API Credits and 1 month free of Mastra Platform.


The best project using Durable Actors will get an iPhone duo. 

The best project built using Agent Relay will get a Mac mini.

The project deemed the “most likely to scale to millions” will receive $1K in credits from Supabase 


More prizes will be announced!

### Don’t Know What Actors/Durable Objects Are?

Here are some great resources:
\-[ https://boristane.com/blog/what-are-cloudflare-durable-objects/](https://boristane.com/blog/what-are-cloudflare-durable-objects/)

\-[ https://x.com/aboodman/status/2088155104851657110](https://x.com/aboodman/status/2088155104851657110)
